transport.framing: JSON-RPC 2.0; headless: one JSON object per line on stdio; app: HTTP POST /rpc
transport.auth: app endpoint: "Authorization: Bearer <session token>", loopback only, off by default

FaceRef.description: Stable face reference. `signature` is optional on input; the server fills it from the current evaluation.

EdgeRef.description: Stable edge reference (`key` is "<faceKeyA>|<faceKeyB>"). `signature` is optional on input.

select.description: CadQuery-style selector: "+Z"/"-X" (planar faces facing / lines along), "|Z" (parallel), "#Z" (perpendicular), ">Z"/"<Z" (max/min along axis), "%PLANE", "%CYLINDER", "%LINE", "%CIRCLE"; combine with " and ".

overhangAngleDeg.description: Faces steeper than this from vertical need support (default 45).

customVolume.description: Build volume X, Y, Z in mm (buildVolume custom).

PrintSettings.description: Printability thresholds, material and printer. Build direction is +Z.

SketchShape.description: Convenience shape, expanded into entities + constraints + dimensions (fully dimensioned: position from the sketch origin and size), like a rectangle/circle drawn and dimensioned in the app.

oneOf.description: Axis-aligned rectangle in sketch (u, v) coordinates; (x, y) is a corner. Dimension roles: x, y, width, height.
Circle. Dimension roles: cx, cy, diameter.

SketchEntity.description: Sketch geometry in the sketch frame (u, v) mm, always the last solved state. Points are referenced by id; "origin" is the fixed sketch origin (never stored). Construction geometry never bounds a profile (e.g. a revolve axis line).

oneOf.description: Counter-clockwise from start to end around center.
Ellipse by its centre and the end points of its major and minor axis (the minor point is kept perpendicular; minor radius ≤ major radius).
Elliptical arc, counter-clockwise from start to end on the ellipse (centre, major, minor).

Cubic spline: `fit` passes through `points` (C2, chord-length; `handles` = end tangent handles, the first/last Bézier control point); `control` uses `points` as the control polygon of a clamped B-spline (`knots` only after a split). The same point as first and last closes it.

Text at `anchor` (baseline start): `height` is the cap height (mm), `angle` degrees; `outline` stores the glyph outlines (SVG path data, 1 = cap height) so the document needs no font. Each glyph is a profile (region keys "<textId>.<n>"). Create it with sketch.addText.

SketchConstraint.description: refs: coincident 2 points; horizontal/vertical 1 line or 2 points; parallel/perpendicular 2 lines; tangent 2 curves (one round, or line+ellipse, or a spline and a line/arc/spline sharing an end point); equal 2 lines or 2 round; fixed 1 point/curve; midpoint point + line; symmetric 2 points + line/point; concentric 2 round/elliptic; pointOnObject point + line/circle/arc/ellipse; translate points p, q, a, b (q − p = b − a, linear pattern); rotate points p, q, c with `value` degrees (circular pattern).

SketchDimension.description: Driving dimension (mm, angle in degrees); `driven: true` makes it a reference dimension that only measures (sketch.setReference). `offset`/`along` place the label. refs: distance 1 line / 2 points / point + line / 2 parallel lines; horizontal/verticalDistance 1 line or 2 points; radius/diameter 1 circle/arc; angle 2 lines. `expression` (e.g. "d1 / 2 + 3") uses names of other dimensions of the sketch.

oneOf.description: Every closed region of the sketch (fused) unless `regions` lists region keys (sketches.list → regions[].key).
Push/pull of a planar body face along its outward normal (Extrude); a planar face as profile (Revolve/Sweep/Loft).
A world axis direction through `origin` (default the world origin).
A straight body edge, or the axis of a circular edge.
A sketch line by entity id (construction lines included), e.g. a revolve centre line.
A connected chain of body edges.
The closed outer outline of a sketch region.
A straight world line.
`angle` is the total angle in degrees; 360 spreads the instances evenly.
One region of a sketch (`regionKey`), or every region.

EdgeRule.description: Edges picked by rule, re-evaluated on every replay: every edge of a face, or every sharp concave (inside) / convex (outside) edge of a body.

oneOf.description: A point in the face plane frame (for axis-aligned faces the world axes of the parallel construction plane: XY u=X v=Y, XZ u=X v=Z, YZ u=Y v=Z).
A sketch point entity, or a circle/arc (its centre), projected onto the face.
Through the whole body.

ShellFaceThickness.description: The wall growing from `face` gets its own thickness.

sketch.label: Sketch
sketch.summary: Constrained 2D sketch on a construction plane or a planar body face (mm, sketch u/v): entities, constraints and driving dimensions, solved by planeGCS on every write. Profiles are the detected closed regions (sketches.list → regions). Input shorthand: `profiles: [SketchShape]` adds fully dimensioned rectangles/circles.

projections.description: Projected body geometry {id, source: {kind: "edge"|"face", ref}, entities}; created by sketch.project, re-derived from the source on every evaluation.

regionMemory.description: Region fingerprints {key, sample, area, box} recorded on every write (geometric re-binding of redrawn profiles); maintained by the server.

extrude.label: Extrude
extrude.summary: Extrudes sketch profiles (or pushes/pulls a planar face) along the sketch normal; negative distance goes the other way.

fillet.label: Fillet
fillet.summary: Rounds edges of one body (exact B-rep fillet): constant radius, or variable from `radius` to `radius2`; edges picked one by one and/or by `rules` (all edges of a face, all concave/convex edges).

radius2.description: Variable radius: `radius` at the start of each edge chain, `radius2` at its end.

chamfer.label: Chamfer
chamfer.summary: Bevels edges of one body: equal distance, two distances, or distance and angle; edges picked and/or by `rules`.

flip.description: Measure `distance` on the other face of each edge (default: the face with the smaller key).

shell.label: Shell
shell.summary: Hollows a body, opening the given faces; walls grow inwards (or outwards with `direction`), walls listed in `faceThickness` get their own thickness.

clearance.description: Outward shells only: the cavity is the body grown by this gap (e.g. 0.2 mm for a printed case that fits over the part).

boolean.label: Boolean
boolean.summary: Union/subtract/intersect; the tool bodies are consumed unless `keepTools`.

move.label: Move
move.summary: Translates a body by (dx, dy, dz) mm.

setAppearance.label: Appearance
setAppearance.summary: Sets a body display color (#RRGGBB); written to 3MF/STEP.

importStep.label: Import
importStep.summary: A STEP file embedded (base64) as one history step producing bodies.

revolve.label: Revolve
revolve.summary: Revolves a profile about an axis (world axis, body edge or sketch line — e.g. a construction centre line); New/Join/Cut like Extrude. The axis must not cross the profile.

angle.description: Degrees; 360 is a full revolution, negative turns the other way.

operation.description: New body, or join/cut into `targetBodyId` (default: the most recently changed body).

sweep.label: Sweep
sweep.summary: Sweeps a profile (without holes) along a path (edge chain, sketch region outline or straight line); New/Join/Cut.

operation.description: New body, or join/cut into `targetBodyId` (default: the most recently changed body).

loft.label: Loft
loft.summary: Lofts through two or more single profiles on different planes, in order; smooth or ruled; New/Join/Cut.

operation.description: New body, or join/cut into `targetBodyId` (default: the most recently changed body).

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.summary: Mirrors bodies across a plane; with keepOriginal (default) the mirror images are new bodies.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.summary: Copies bodies in a linear or circular pattern (independent copies).

split.label: Split
split.summary: Splits a body by a plane into two bodies (the positive side becomes new).

transform.label: Move/Rotate
transform.summary: Rigid transform of a body: rotate rx, ry, rz degrees about world X, then Y, then Z through `pivot`, then translate (dx, dy, dz); `copy` makes a new body.

params.description: Missing components default to 0, the pivot to the world origin.

align.label: Align
align.summary: Moves a body so its planar `face` lies on the plane of `target` (a planar face of another body): face to face by default, same direction with flip; `offset` leaves a gap; `center` slides the face centres together.

offsetFace.label: Offset Face
offsetFace.summary: Offsets faces of one body along their normals: positive adds material, negative removes it (e.g. enlarges a hole).

deleteFace.label: Delete Face
deleteFace.summary: Removes faces (holes, fillets, chamfers) of one body and heals it.

hole.label: Hole
hole.summary: Simple, counterbored or countersunk holes on a planar face, blind or through all, several per feature. Standard sizes are presets of the tool (ISO 273 clearance M2-M10, tap drill, DIN 974-1 counterbores, ISO 15065 countersinks) and are stored as plain diameters; `thread` is a cosmetic label only (no thread geometry).

preset.description: Display name of the preset the size came from.

emboss.label: Emboss
emboss.summary: Raises (positive depth) or engraves (negative) sketch profiles on a face: projected onto a planar face (sketch parallel to it), or wrapped around a cylinder keeping surface lengths (sketch plane parallel to the axis; wrap centre where the sketch normal through the axis meets the surface).

draft.label: Draft
draft.summary: Tilts planar, cylindrical or conical faces by `angle` degrees about their intersection with the neutral plane (a face: the pull points into the body; a construction plane: along its normal; `flip` reverses). Positive removes material on the pull side.

rib.label: Rib
rib.summary: A rib/web/gusset from open sketch lines: thickened symmetrically across the sketch plane and filled from each line until it meets the body (`flip` fills the other side); joined into `targetBodyId` (default: the last changed body).

thicken.label: Thicken
thicken.summary: Turns body faces (or sketch profiles) into a solid of `thickness`: outside along the normal, inside, or both; New/Join/Cut like Extrude.

operation.description: New body, or join/cut into `targetBodyId` (default: the most recently changed body).
